findings.summary: The interface ignores the user’s dark theme preference.
findings.evidence: The prefers-color-scheme: dark screenshot is pixel-identical in palette to the default screenshot; the CSS feature probe found no prefers-color-scheme rule or color-scheme declaration.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and define light/dark surface and text tokens with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Page changes are abrupt and provide no transition cue.
findings.evidence: The platform probe found no view-transition CSS and navigation uses ordinary full-page links without a cross-document view-transition declaration.
findings.suggestedFix: Add @view-transition { navigation: auto } and restrained directional transitions, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.evidence: The authored CSS contains * { outline: none; }; focusing the logo, nav links, and category cards produced outline-style:none and no box shadow.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the global outline reset and add a high-contrast :focus-visible treatment with adequate offset.

findings.evidence: DOM probes on the homepage, category, and video templates all found zero h1-h6 elements, despite each page containing a primary topic and long content grid.
findings.suggestedFix: Add one descriptive h1 per template and use ordered section headings; preserve existing landmark elements.

findings.summary: Unknown URLs silently redirect to the homepage instead of presenting a real not-found state.
findings.evidence: A request to /this-route-does-not-exist-404 returned 301 Location: /, then the normal homepage; the rendered state offered no explanation or recovery specific to the failed URL.
findings.suggestedFix: Return HTTP 404 with a concise not-found page, search/category links, and a clear route back to the homepage.

findings.summary: Indexing signals are incomplete and error behavior can create soft-404 duplicates.
findings.evidence: No canonical URL was present on sampled pages, /sitemap.xml returned 404, and unknown URLs redirect to an indexable homepage. robots.txt otherwise allows public crawling.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish a sitemap, add self-referencing canonicals to public templates, and return a genuine 404 for unknown routes.

findings.summary: Video detail pages lack useful structured and social metadata.
findings.evidence: The sampled video page contained no JSON-LD, no og:title or og:image, and reused the category title/description; only og:description was present.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate VideoObject JSON-LD plus unique Open Graph title, description, image, and URL matching the visible video.

findings.summary: Baseline transport and browser security defenses are missing.
findings.evidence: The HTTPS response lacked CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy, and a minimal Permissions-Policy; test in report-only mode before enforcing CSP.

findings.summary: First-party identifier cookies are sent without Secure and use SameSite=None.
findings.evidence: CDP found cid (365 days) and vctx (30 days), both Secure=false, HttpOnly=false, and SameSite=None on an HTTPS site.
findings.suggestedFix: Set Secure and an appropriate SameSite=Lax/Strict policy; use HttpOnly where JavaScript does not need access, reduce retention, and document purpose.

findings.summary: Persistent identifiers and a third-party counter are used without visible minimisation evidence.
findings.evidence: The page sets a year-long cid and 30-day vctx cookie and contacts counter.yadro.ru. The network footprint is small, but purpose/consent and retention minimisation are not apparent on the primary path.
findings.suggestedFix: Audit whether identifiers are necessary, shorten retention, avoid cross-context SameSite=None, and replace or defer third-party counting until an appropriate consent basis exists.

findings.summary: Thumbnail delivery misses responsive and modern image opportunities.
findings.evidence: The image probe found 100/100 images without srcset and 25 legacy PNG/JPEG resources, while the mobile grid displays thumbnails at substantially different sizes. The initial HAR remained modest at 358 KB because lazy loading limited requests.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP thumbnail variants and width-based srcset/sizes while retaining lazy loading and reserved aspect ratios.
